Al perder el balón, los más cercanos pre: When you lose the ball, the nearest players press hard for a few seconds to win it back before the opponent gets organised. If it isn't won back, the team drops back and reorganises.
Al recuperar el balón, los extremos y el: When we win the ball back, the wingers and the 9 push up again: 4-3-3 once more. This way, the same team defends with 5 in midfield and attacks with 3 up front.

Con balón, los carrileros dan amplitud y: In possession, the wing-backs give width and you attack with five; out of possession, they drop and you defend with five at the back. It demands wing-backs with a big engine and centre-backs comfortable defending in open space.

Con balón, se mueve entre la defensa y e: In possession, he moves between the opponent's defence and midfield to receive facing forward and play the final pass or shoot. Out of possession, he watches the opposing holding midfielder and is the striker's first support in the press.

Mientras atacas, conviene dejar jugadore: While attacking, it helps to keep players in position to stop the counter, often two or three (for example, two centre-backs and a holding midfielder). How many depends on the opposing forwards, the score and the risk you want to take. Attacking well also means being ready to lose the ball.
Con balón, suele ofrecerse por delante d: In possession, he usually shows in front of the centre-backs to receive and, if the pressure lets him turn, switch the play. Out of possession, he protects the area in front of the defence, cuts out passes through the middle and keeps the team balanced.
1 minuto para explicar la norma y 4 seri: 1 minute to explain the rule and 4 sets of 4 minutes with 1 minute of rest between sets (1 + 16 + 3 = 20). A point for winning the ball back within 5 seconds.
Busca distintas alturas y carriles para: Look for different heights and lanes to offer passing options. Avoid lining up with team-mates when that lets the opponent close several options at once. Movement and support can open passing lines, depending on the pressure and where team-mates and opponents are.
Si vas perdiendo, ajusta el riesgo según: If you are behind, adjust the risk to the time left, the goal difference and how the opponent is defending. You can push players further forward, add more presence in the finishing zone or change the team’s organisation. Coordinate those changes and decide how to protect against a possible loss of the ball based on the counter-attack threat.
